Job Title: Senior Angular Developer
Experience: 5+ years
Location: Hybrid: Hyderabad or Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Angular
- TypeScript
Good to have:
- HTML
- Jest
- NgRx
- RxJS

Responsibilities:
- Join a growing product engineering team at a fast-moving fintech startup building customer-facing web applications. Lead front-end design and implementation for new features and modules using Angular and TypeScript.
- Translate product requirements and UX designs into maintainable, testable Angular code, ensuring performance and accessibility across browsers and devices.
- Design and implement state management solutions using NgRx where applicable; leverage RxJS for reactive data flows and asynchronous operations.
- Drive unit testing practices with Jest and contribute to CI pipelines to maintain high code quality and fast delivery cycles.
- Mentor mid-level and junior developers on Angular best practices, TypeScript patterns, and front-end architecture decisions.
- Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA, and product managers to scope work, estimate tasks, and deliver end-to-end solutions.
- Participate in code reviews, refactoring efforts, and technical discussions to improve maintainability and reduce technical debt.
- Troubleshoot production issues, analyze root causes, and implement robust fixes and performance optimizations.
- Contribute to front-end standards, component libraries, and documentation to accelerate team delivery.
